comment: Archives packed into the APK as assets/components/<file> (stored, not recompressed) and unpacked on first start. Gradle (bundleComponents) copies them from -PcomponentsDir (default /var/tmp/panvk/components) and fails on any sha256 mismatch; the DXVM component is passed separately with -PdxvmWcp because it is built in the same run and cannot carry a committed pin. Fetched: scripts/fetch-launcher-components.sh. This fork drops the launcher's vkd3d-proton, Box64-WoW64 and audio components (FORK.md) and replaces PanPlay's DXVK with DXVM, so fexcore is the only component that still needs an out-of-band build (scripts/build-fex-windows.sh) for 32-bit (WoW64) support; the arm64ec harness this app runs does not need it. -PbundleComponents=false builds a download-only APK (rootfs and Proton are installable from the Components screen).
